channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: At NFL games this season, drone defense tech aims to bring down disruptions
item.description: The NFL told CNBC it recorded 10,852 drone violations over stadiums between 2021 and 2025. The Jaguars became the first team to sign a drone defense firm.

item.title: Debt-hungry AI companies face increased risk as bond yields spike
item.description: The AI infrastructure buildout shows no sign of slowing, but the surge in Treasury yields means it's at least going to cost more.

item.title: Wall Street money takes back over from small investors as driving force of the stock market
item.description: One firm sees a "reasonably constructive signal for risk appetite" among institutional investors.

item.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei set to meet with Trump after missing state dinner
item.description: As top tech CEOs rubbed elbows at President Trump's glitzy dinner for Chinese President Xi on Thursday, Anthropic's CEO was noticeably absent.

item.title: Meta's Muse agent is attacking one of the economy's most profitable weak spots
item.description: Meta's Muse AI personal agent will work over your credit card spending if you don't mind the invasion. How big a threat is it to the subscription economy?

item.title: This key part of the stock market could be headed for a meaningful breakout
item.description: The Technology Select SPDR (XLK) has an opportunity to turn a bounce into a more meaningful breakout, says Frank Cappelleri.

item.title: Trump says men arrested at UK air base used by U.S. forces were looking to do 'big damage'
item.description: British counterterrorism detectives said police received a call about three suspicious vehicles that appeared to be traveling towards RAF Fairford early Sunday.

item.title: Iran's foreign minister says Tehran ready for 'doomsday' war with U.S., but leaves diplomacy on the table
item.description: Iran's foreign minister says talks are the only way to break the deadlock, while its navy says it's analyzing data from a captured U.S. underwater drone.

item.title: China weighs allowing ByteDance, Alibaba to buy new Nvidia chips, The Information reports
item.description: China officials recently asked companies including ByteDance and Alibaba to report their plans to purchase Nvidia's RTX PRO 5500 chips, according to the report.

item.title: Apple faces $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict over iPhone and Apple Watch haptics
item.description: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed claims from two haptics patents. Apple plans to appeal.

item.title: Audemars Piguet says its Royal Pop collaboration with Swatch is breaking sales records, despite luxury watch slump and tariffs
item.description: Swiss luxury watchmaker Audemars Piguet says its sales and engagement are breaking records after its risky, eye-catching Royal Pop collaboration with Swatch.

item.title: Supply glut, lab-grown alternatives: What's behind the fall of diamond prices to record lows
item.description: Diamond prices are falling, leading investors and others to wonder whether the gemstones are losing their luster.

item.title: Nor'easter delays hundreds of flights, airlines waive change fees
item.description: Flight disruptions were rising in Boston over the weekend.

item.title: Bank of America says Nvidia and these other stocks are on sale
item.description: Bank of America named several stocks that it said are undervalued.

item.title: Powerful nor'easter batters the U.S. Northeast, causing coastal flooding, outages and at least 1 death
item.description: Tens of millions of people were in the path of the nor'easter, which was forecast to affect the mid-Atlantic area and New England throughout the weekend.

item.title: The 10-year Treasury yield is at its highest in nearly two decades. How we got here
item.description: The benchmark yield has climbed to a 19-year high, fueled by sticky inflation, heavy bond issuance and an AI-fueled investment boom.

item.title: History shows financial calamities occur when rates rise rapidly like this: 'Something always breaks'
item.description: The 10-year Treasury note yield is spiking to levels not seen in years, and that may be a bad omen for financial markets.

item.title: OpenAI expands review of model behavior after more rogue agent incidents emerge
item.description: OpenAI is conducting an extensive review of misaligned model activity after disclosures involving an Australian government portal and other websites.

item.title: Top Wall Street analysts like these 3 dividend stocks for steady income
item.description: Investors seeking a stable income stream can enhance their portfolios with the addition of dividend stocks.

item.title: 'Funflation' is on the rise as hobbies get pricier, but consumers keep spending anyway
item.description: Consumers are spending more on hobbies like arts and crafts and outdoor sports, as it gets more expensive to travel due to increased airfare.

item.title: Here are the 4 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead
item.description: Both sides of the Fed's dual mandate are in focus. Plus, Micron reports and Eli Lilly delivers updates on its obesity pipeline.

item.title: Using BNPL for bills? Here’s what to try first, plus other ways to cover expenses
item.description: When it comes to your bills, consider a payment plan before resorting to BNPL. For other expenses, a balance transfer card or personal loan can help.

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic CEOs called to appear at Australian AI probe
item.description: The Australian Medicare breach is one of the highest-profile incidents of AI agents accessing external systems outside the U.S.

item.title: This may be the ‘missing piece’ for investors looking to boost AI exposure
item.description: Matthews Asia portfolio manager Andrew Mattock delivers a strategy that revolves around the world's second largest economy.

item.title: Boeing flags 737 Max software glitch affecting some automated approach functions
item.description: Boeing identified a software issue on some 737 Max aircraft that can affect automated vertical navigation functions after a missed approach.

item.title: Trump says he approved new fuel economy standards, rolling back Biden-era rules
item.description: The new fuel economy standards will reverse the Biden administration's stricter policies meant to spur electric vehicle adoption.

item.title: Berkshire adds to nearly doubled stake in slumping homebuilder
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway has increased its bet on a long-term recovery for the struggling U.S. housing market by nearly doubling its stake in Lennar, the nation's second largest homebuilder, since the beginning of July.

item.title: Trump, Xi wrap state visit centered on spectacle over substance. Here are the top takeaways
item.description: President Trump and Chinese leader Xi went heavy on the ceremony and light on deliverables as they danced around Taiwan and Iran during two days in Washington.

item.title: White House moves to block $810 million in funding through pocket rescission
item.description: The White House is moving to block $810 million in appropriated funds days before the fiscal year ends, drawing objections over the maneuver.

item.title: China, U.S. agree to $30 billion tariff cut, AI dialogue during Xi visit, Beijing says
item.description: The three-day summit ​between Xi and President Donald Trump, which ended on Friday, showcased personal diplomacy rather than big public breakthroughs.
